title: Logs

access.label: Access
access.hint: Every request to the site, with the visitor's address.

error.label: Web server errors
error.hint: What nginx reports for the site, including PHP messages it receives.

php.label: PHP errors
php.hint: Warnings and errors of the site's PHP, written by PHP-FPM.

app.label: App
app.hint: What the site's Node.js app writes to its output and error output.

wordpress.label: WordPress install
wordpress.hint: The WP-CLI output of the last WordPress install from the panel. Empty if WordPress was never installed here.

empty: The log is empty so far.
rotated: — the log was rotated, new file —
pausedHint: Paused: press Follow to see new lines.
retentionAdmin: The server deletes old logs after the days an administrator set under System.
retentionOther: The server deletes old logs after the days an administrator set. Ask them if you need logs for longer.

retention.title: Log retention
retention.intro: One value for every site on this server: access, web server, PHP, app and WordPress install logs, and nginx's logs of requests for no site. Logs are rotated daily and deleted after this many days. Match it to what your privacy policy and data processing agreements promise.
retention.range: {{min}} to {{max}} days, default {{default}}. A shorter time deletes older logs at the next daily rotation.
retention.system: The panel's own logs and the system journal keep the settings of the distribution.
retention.done_one: Logs are kept for {{count}} day from the next rotation on.
retention.done_other: Logs are kept for {{count}} days from the next rotation on.

check.whole: Enter a whole number of days.

errors.precondition: The log cannot be read on this server: {{reason}}.
errors.notFound: There is no such site or log.
errors.unreachable: The log could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
